svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: RR intervals: from heartbeats on an ECG to an RR tachogram
svg.desc: Top: an ECG trace with six heartbeats; the five RR intervals between their R peaks are, measured as 800, 840, 880, 850 and 800 milliseconds. Bottom: the same intervals plotted as points against beat number, forming an RR tachogram. Heart rate variability is the variation in these intervals.
svg.text: 1. ECG: find each R peak, then time the gap between peaks
2. RR tachogram: plot each interval against beat number
